blurb.bm: Komuniti tepi air. Ini kawasan kediaman: kekal di laluan awam dan hormati rumah penduduk.
blurb.en: A waterfront community. People live here: keep to public areas and respect their homes.

ask.bm: Berapa bot yang tertambat di jeti ini?
ask.en: How many boats are moored at this jetty?

why.bm: Betul, dua bot! Penduduk jeti masih guna bot.
why.en: Yes, two boats! Jetty residents still use boats.

intro.bm: Jeti Kaum ialah perkampungan atas air di pesisir George Town. Jeti Chew ialah yang paling banyak dikunjungi.
intro.en: The Clan Jetties are waterfront villages on George Town’s shore. Chew Jetty is the most visited.

bm: Sembilan perkampungan jeti pernah dibina. Tujuh masih ada hari ini: Ong, Lim, Chew, Tan, Lee, Campuran dan Yeoh.
Komuniti ini berkembang antara tahun 1880-an hingga 1960-an.
Keluarga Chew berasal dari Tong’an, Xiamen di China.
en: Nine jetty villages were built. Seven remain today: Ong, Lim, Chew, Tan, Lee, Mixed Clan and Yeoh.
The community grew between the 1880s and the 1960s.
The Chew clan came from Tong’an, Xiamen in China.

bm: Rumah kayu yang disambung oleh laluan papan
Ingat: ini rumah orang, jadi cakap perlahan
en: Timber houses linked by plank walkways
Small clan shrines on the jetty
Remember: these are homes, so keep your voice down

fun.bm: Pada hari kesembilan Tahun Baru Cina, Jeti Chew menjadi tumpuan sambutan hari lahir Maharaja Jed.
fun.en: On the ninth day of Chinese New Year, Chew Jetty is the focus of the Jade Emperor’s birthday celebration.
